Proof in the paper: The Au/Ni(111) surface alloy was prepared and investigated using infrared reflection absorption spectroscopy (IRAS), temperature-programmed desorption/reaction (TPD/TPR), and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. The surface was formed by depositing mass-selected Au+ ions onto the Ni(111) surface at 300 K, and the total coverage of the deposited Au was determined from the integrated Au+ neutralization current on the sample. The surface alloy with Au atoms substituted into the topmost surface layer of the Ni substrate was used to investigate the NO-CO reaction steps.
